content.title: Typical Timelines
content.summary: The article outlines the timelines for various city development review processes, including Development Review, Public Improvement Plan Review, Building Plan Review, and Site & Stormwater Review. Each process has specific steps with estimated durations, such as a total of 26 weeks for public hearing cases in development review and up to 15.4 weeks for public improvement plans with 60 or more sheets. It emphasizes that building permits cannot be issued until all development review processes are complete.
content.body:
## Development Review

| Review Process | Administrative Review | Public Hearing Cases |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Completeness Check and 1st staff review | 4 weeks | 4 weeks |
| Customer review and amended submission | Varies | 3 weeks |
| 2nd staff review | 4 weeks | 4 weeks |
| Customer review and amended submission | Varies | 3 weeks |
| 3rd staff review | 2 weeks | 2 weeks |
| Planning Commission Meeting | N/A | 4 weeks |
| City Council | N/A | 6 weeks |
| Total number of weeks | Varies (see note) | 26 |
Development review process steps and timeline

**Note**: Depends on the amount of time that applicant requires for resubmission.

## Public Improvement Plan Review

| Review Process | 1 to 59 Sheets | 60 or More Sheets |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Completeness Check | 1 week | 2 weeks |
| 1st staff review | 2 weeks | 3 weeks |
| Collate and Review Staff Report | 1 week | 1 week |
| Customer review and revisions | 4 weeks | 6 weeks |
| 2nd staff review | 3 weeks | 5 weeks |
| Customer review and revisions | 3 weeks | 5 weeks |
| Final staff review and approval | 1 week | 2 weeks |
| Total number of business days | 56 | 77 |
| Total number of weeks | 11.2 | 15.4 |
Public improvement plan review process steps and timeline

**Note**: Please contact Engineering Services for estimated timeline if your plan set is 80+ sheets.

## Building Plan Review

| Review Process | Tenant Finish | Single-Family | 1 to 100 Sheet | 101 or More Sheets |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Staff review for code compliance | 4 weeks | 4 weeks | 4 weeks | 6 weeks |
| Customer review and code corrections | 2 weeks | 2 weeks | 2 weeks | 4 weeks |
| Staff review for code compliance | 2 weeks | 2 weeks | 2 weeks | 4 weeks |
| Total number of business days | 40 | 40 | 40 | 70 |
| Total number of weeks | 8 | 8 | 8 | 14 |
Building plan review process steps and timeline

**Notes**: Most residential projects under $30K can be reviewed immediately at the building counter on the second floor at City Hall; Building permits cannot be issued until all Development Review processes are complete.

## Site & Stormwater Review

| Review Process | 1 to 5 Sheets | 1 to 10 Sheets | 11 or More Sheets |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1st staff review | 3 weeks | 3 weeks | 4 weeks |
| Customer review and revisions | 3 weeks | 3 weeks | 4 weeks |
| 2nd staff review | 3 weeks | 3 weeks | 4 weeks |
| Customer review and revisions | 3 weeks | 3 weeks | 4 weeks |
| Final staff review and approval | 2 weeks | 2 weeks | 3 weeks |
| Total number of business days | 56 | 56 | 77 |
| Total number of weeks | 11.2 | 11.2 | 15.4 |
Site and stormwater review process steps and timeline
